Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pH), mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with monocytosis and basophilia, and elevated creatinine and alkaline phosphatase.
